name: M0 — Clinic Config Lookup (multi-clinic, zero node edits)

parameters.content:
## M0 Clinic Config Lookup
Drop-in replacement for the hard-coded 'Load Clinic Config' Set node in M1. Onboarding a new clinic then means **adding a row to the Clinics sheet — no node edits**.

### One-time bootstrap
The ONLY hard-coded value is the master spreadsheet ID (the sheet that holds the `Clinics` tab). Put it in the 'Read Clinics Tab' node's Document ID (replace `{{GOOGLE_SHEET_ID}}`). Everything else — including each clinic's own sheet_id — comes from the row.

### How clinic_id is chosen
'Resolve clinic_id' reads it from the chat widget URL query param (`?clinic_id=smilecare`) if present, else falls back to DEFAULT_CLINIC_ID. Set your default below.

### To splice into M1
1. In M1, delete the 'Load Clinic Config' Set node.
2. Copy 'Resolve clinic_id', 'Read Clinics Tab', and 'Build Clinic Config' from here (select all three → Ctrl/Cmd-C, paste into M1).
3. Wire: Chat Trigger → Resolve clinic_id → Read Clinics Tab → Build Clinic Config → Intent + Extract.
'Build Clinic Config' outputs the EXACT same fields the old Set node did (plus chatInput/sessionId), so the rest of M1 is unchanged.

### Clinics tab columns (row 1)
clinic_id | clinic_name | address | hours_json | staff_email | staff_phone | twilio_from | pinecone_index | pinecone_namespace | sheet_id | drive_folder_id | sms_enabled_patient | sms_enabled_staff | pinecone_min_score | test_mode | after_hours_message

(booleans as TRUE/FALSE, pinecone_min_score as a number e.g. 0.78)

From here, wire into M1's
**'Intent + Extract'** node.
The output object matches the
old Set node 1:1.
